verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official JavaScript SDK for web event tracking and an HTTP API for sending events from servers. An event-spec section exists in the docs, and RudderStack says one SDK sends standardized data to hundreds of destinations. A community user also reports collecting analytics across various platforms. Missing for 10: evidence of official mobile and server-side SDKs, explicit documentation of track/identify/page calls in the tracking spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK spec conformance.
